title: FCC Field Assignment
pages:
TO: Field Engineer, Monitoring Unit 14
FROM: R. Haskell, District Engineer
DATE: October 22, 1962
RE: Complaint 62-1147, WKVR-TV, Halloway Falls, Ohio

An anonymous complainant reports intermittent interference on Channel 7: a second, faint picture showing programs WKVR says it never aired.

Proceed to WKVR-TV and determine the source. The night operator has agreed to assist.

For reference: WKVR-TV is licensed for 50 KILOWATTS effective radiated visual power on Channel 7 (visual carrier 175.25 Mc). Any operation above that figure violates the license and Commission rules.

You carry the Commission's authority to inspect the transmitter plant, its logs and its records. Report your findings in writing.

R. Haskell
District Engineer
note: Complaint 62-1147: a second faint picture on Channel 7. WKVR-TV is licensed for 50 kilowatts visual power. Anything above that is a violation.

title: Night Operator's Interference Log
header: WKVR Master Control - kept by R. Delgado
pages:
VIEWER CALLS - 'GHOST PICTURE' ON CH. 7

Tue Sep 18 - 3 calls. Faint second picture, 'like a negative'.
Tue Sep 25 - 7 calls. Ghost shows a game show we don't carry.
Tue Oct 2 - 4 calls. Ghost picture rolls slowly upward.
Tue Oct 9 - 11 calls. Dot Kimball on the ghost - 'in color'.

Tue Oct 16 - 9 calls. Mr. P. stayed late in the hall again.
Tue Oct 23 - tonight. Ghost on the monitors since 10 PM.

NOTES: Never on any other night. Sits right under our own carrier, phase-inverted. Our picture swamps it unless you null ours out. H-hold has to come way down to stop the roll.
- R.D.
note: Ghost pictures reported ONLY on Tuesday nights: Sep 18, Sep 25, Oct 2, Oct 9, Oct 16 and tonight. Tuning: right under Channel 7's own carrier, phase-inverted, rolling - null our carrier, bring the H-hold well down.

title: Letter from Futura Corporation

Dear Mr. Brandt,

Our continued sponsorship of WKVR is contingent upon Thursday's demonstration achieving reliable single-hop reception in Los Angeles. Our engineers estimate that this will require at least 200 kilowatts.

The Model 63 kitchen remains STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL until our January launch. Please ensure no mention of it is made on the air.

R. Maddox
Vice President, Advertising
note: Futura wants 200 kilowatts for Thursday. The 'Model 63' kitchen is confidential until January - nobody may mention it on air.

title: Emergency Shutdown Procedure
header: Skyhook Overdrive - Rev. 3 - June 1962 - POST AT CONSOLE
pages:
IN AN EMERGENCY:

1. Open COOLANT VALVE 3. Confirm flow on the gauge.
2. Reduce FINAL DRIVE to zero.
3. Open the PLATE BREAKER.
4. Close the ANTENNA GROUND.

NEVER open the plate breaker under drive.
NEVER ground a live antenna.

A. Penrose, Chief Engineer
note: Posted at the console (Rev. 3, June 1962): 1) open coolant VALVE 3, 2) final drive to zero, 3) open plate breaker, 4) close antenna ground.
